candidates.claim: OT-facing port sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/5 is configured as a trunk (switchport mode trunk) with no approved VLAN set, although OT-facing ports must be access ports in VLAN 10 and only approved trunks are authorized.
candidates.remediation: Return Gi1/0/5 to access mode in VLAN 10, or document and approve it as a trunk with an approved VLAN set.

candidates.claim: The approved baseline has sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/5 as an access port in VLAN 10 with portfast, but the current snapshot modifies it to switchport mode trunk.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this baseline deviation: confirm whether the trunk mode on Gi1/0/5 is authorized, and revert it to the baseline access configuration if not.

clarifications.question: The registry bars SVIs with IP addresses only for zone VLANs 10, 20 and 30, while I3 refers to zone VLANs generally and the zone table lists MGMT as VLAN 99. Are the management SVIs Vlan99 with IP addresses on sw-core-01 (10.10.99.10/24), sw-it-01 (10.10.99.13/24) and sw-ot-01 (10.10.99.11/24) compliant with I3?
